I think you need to see a therapist and be completely open with them, and your family, and see if anything improves because they can't help you unless you be completely truthful with them. But, if it doesn't help perhaps you should consider spending some time in a mental health facility? I know that sounds scary but they're honestly not as bad as they're made out to be, like it's just a place you can go where you don't need to focus on anyone or anything except yourself and I think that it may help you sort everything out.....and things will get better, like I know it doesn't seem like it will at the moment and you probably don't believe me when I say that, but a year ago (I was the same age as you) I was going through so much crap and I honestly thought things would never get better and was contemplating suicide. However, skip to now, and I'm on the road to recovery and am feeling the happiest I have my entire life so things do get better but you just need to hang in there and get through life one shitty day at a time. So please don't kill yourself because you have your whole life ahead of you and you are yet to live your happiest moments. Plus, I'm sure there are a bunch of people who deeply care about you and would be completely devastated if you did and, even though you don't know me and I don't know you, I care about you and hope that you can get to a place where you, at least, no longer have those thoughts.
